job.job_title: Lead Agentic AI Engineer-Opening with CAPCO
job.job_description:
Lead Agentic AI SDLC Engineer
We are seeking a hands-on engineer to design and implement a secure, governed Agentic AI software development lifecycle. The role will build AI agents that support architecture decisions, requirements, design, task creation, development, QA, security review, and delivery.
Responsibilities


Design and implement specification-driven AI agents across the SDLC.

Create agent prompts, policies, configurations, and structured handoffs.

Integrate agents with Git, CI/CD, issue tracking, and engineering tools through MCP or APIs.

Enforce least-privilege access, human approval gates, and separation of duties.

Implement end-to-end traceability from architecture decisions to requirements, code, tests, commits, and merge requests.

Build observability and audit capabilities for all agent and tool interactions.

Establish evaluation, security, and quality controls for AI-generated outputs.

Deliver pilot workflows and support adoption across engineering teams.


Required experience

Strong software engineering or platform engineering background.

Hands-on experience with generative AI, LLM agents, tool calling, or workflow orchestration.

Proficiency in Python and experience with Java or another enterprise language.

Knowledge of GitOps, CI/CD, secure software development, threat modeling, and least-privilege design.

Experience integrating APIs, developer tools, observability platforms, and policy controls.

Ability to work across engineering, architecture, security, and governance teams.
